# BuyTCN — Your Personal Buyer in China

> BuyTCN is a China shopping & sourcing agent for people outside China. Send us a link from Taobao, 1688, Pinduoduo, Tmall, Weidian or JD — or just describe what you need — and we purchase it in China, run a basic quality check with photos, consolidate packages and coordinate international shipping. No registration, no Chinese account, no Chinese payment method, no language barrier required.

## What we do
- **Marketplace purchasing** — We buy eligible items from Chinese marketplaces on your behalf, handle seller communication, receive items at our China warehouse, do basic QC (eligible orders) and coordinate international shipping.
- **Supplier / factory sourcing** — For wholesale, custom or business orders we help find Chinese suppliers, wholesalers and manufacturers based on product, quantity, target price and requirements.
- **QC & inspection** — Basic visual/quantity checks with photos for eligible orders before shipment.
- **Package consolidation** — Combine eligible items from multiple sellers so they ship together when possible.
- **International shipping** — Coordinate delivery to your destination, with tracking.

## Pricing (transparent, shown before you confirm)
- Service fee starts at **$20** and decreases progressively as the merchandise value grows (as low as ~5% on the portion above $20,000).
- What you pay = **product cost + China domestic shipping + service fee + international shipping + any other applicable charges**. No guessing, no black box.
- Free quote within 24h. No payment needed to ask. Duties & taxes not included unless stated in the quote.

## How it works (6 steps)
1. Send a product link, photo, description or requirement.
2. We find the right source (marketplace / supplier / manufacturer).
3. You get a clear itemized quote.
4. You confirm and pay.
5. We purchase & inspect (QC photos where eligible).
6. We ship internationally and provide tracking.

## Target customers
- Personal shoppers / gift buyers / small orders
- Wholesale & resellers, e-commerce sellers (Amazon, Shopify, Etsy, own store)
- Custom / private-label & OEM/ODM buyers
- Anyone who can find it in China but can't navigate Chinese marketplaces

## Languages
English (default), Chinese, Spanish, French, Arabic — same content under locale prefixes `/zh/`, `/es/`, `/fr/`, `/ar/`.

## Contact & actions
- **Email:** service@buytcn.com
- **Submit a product link / get a quote:** homepage "Submit a Product Link" section (replies on WhatsApp) or email.
- **Track a package:** enter your tracking number (carriers incl. Cainiao, Yanwen, YunExpress, USPS, DHL, FedEx, UPS, DPD, SF, ZTO, YTO, Yunda, JD, China EMS).

## Restrictions
Some restricted, dangerous, counterfeit or otherwise prohibited products cannot be purchased or shipped. Eligibility depends on product availability, payment, shipping requirements and applicable laws/regulations.
